overview: Memoryless property, mean 1/lambda, min of independent exponentials, conditional probabilities.
coreConcept: f(x)=lambda e^{-lambda x}; P(X>x)=e^{-lambda x}; mean 1/lambda.
hinglishExplanation: Memoryless: P(X>s+t | X>s) = P(X>t). Min of independent exponentials exponential with rate sum. Median = ln2/lambda.
formalDefinition: f(x)=lambda e^{-lambda x}; P(X>x)=e^{-lambda x}; mean 1/lambda.
